$comment: BridgeEscrow post-deploy config for Ethereum (1). `accounts` = addresses authorized to call depositAndBridge / receive releases (authorizeAccount, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE); left empty here and filled per deployment — the deployer EOA for the smoke test, the fund Safes for production. `assets` = LOGICAL bridge symbol -> local token address (registerAsset, MANAGER_ROLE). The symbol is part of the cross-chain invoice identity, so BOTH ends of a lane must register the SAME logical symbol mapped to each chain's local token. USDC here is native Circle USDC (CCTP-eligible).
